title: Luminaires - Particular Requirements - Emergency Lighting
description: Specifies requirements for emergency luminaires for use with electrical light sources on emergency power supplies not exceeding 1000 V.

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Safety Requirements
description: Specifies the safety and interchangeability requirements, together with test methods for LED lamps with integrated means for controlling, intended for domestic and general lighting.

title: Lamp Controlgear - Particular Requirements for DC or AC Supplied Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules
description: Specifies particular safety requirements for electronic controlgear for use on DC supplies up to 250 V and AC supplies up to 1000 V at 50 Hz or 60 Hz.

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - General Requirements
description: Deals with the safety of electrical appliances for household and similar purposes, their rated voltage being not more than 250 V for single-phase appliances and 480 V for other appliances.

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Particular Requirements for Kitchen Machines (Mixers, Blenders, Food Processors)
description: Deals with the safety of electric kitchen machines including food mixers, blenders, meat mincers, coffee grinders, and citrus fruit squeezers for household use.

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets for Domestic and Similar Purposes of Rated Voltage up to and including 250 Volts and Rated Current up to and including 16 Amperes
description: Applies to plugs and fixed or portable socket-outlets for AC only, with or without earthing contact, for domestic and commercial installation.

title: Domestic Pressure Cookers - Specification
description: Specifies requirements for domestic pressure cookers manufactured from aluminium alloys, stainless steel, or composite metals, having capacities between 1 and 20 litres.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement
description: Covers requirements of high strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement in grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, and Fe 600.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification
description: Covers the requirements of steel plates, sections, flats, bars and strips for use in structural work subjected to dynamic or static loading.

title: Protective Helmets for Riders of Two Wheeled Motor Vehicles - Specification
description: Specifies requirements regarding construction, finish, mass, retention system, and protective capability of helmets for riders of two-wheeled motor vehicles.

title: Electric Power Driven Vehicles - Lithium-Ion Based Traction Battery Systems - Safety Requirements
description: Specifies safety requirements and validation tests for lithium-ion secondary cells and battery packs intended for traction power in pure electric and hybrid road vehicles.

title: Electric Vehicle Conductive AC and DC Charging Systems - General Requirements
description: Applies to on-board and off-board equipment for charging electric road vehicles at standard AC supply voltages up to 1000 V and DC voltages up to 1500 V.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification (33, 43 and 53 Grades)
description: Covers the manufacture and chemical and physical requirements of ordinary Portland cement of 33, 43, and 53 grades for general and heavy civil engineering construction.

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement - Specification (Part 1: Fly Ash Based)
description: Covers manufacture and chemical and physical requirements of fly ash based Portland pozzolana cement for masonry, plastering, and general concrete structures.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
description: Prescribes requirements, methods of sampling and test for packaged drinking water filled into hermetically sealed containers of various capacities.

title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water - Specification
description: Prescribes requirements and test protocols for packaged natural mineral water obtained directly from underground sources or springs and packaged at source.

title: Safety of Toys - Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
description: Applies to all toys intended for children under 14 years, establishing criteria for sharp edges, points, small parts (choking hazard), and mechanical strength.

title: Safety of Toys - Part 2: Flammability
description: Specifies categories of flammable materials prohibited in all toys and requirements concerning flammability of toys when subjected to small ignition sources.

title: Safety of Toys - Part 3: Migration of Certain Elements
description: Specifies maximum acceptable levels and methods of extraction for bioavailable lead, cadmium, antimony, arsenic, barium, chromium, mercury, and selenium from toy materials.

title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety - General Requirements
description: Applicable to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment, including electronic business equipment and telecommunication equipment.

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes - Safety Requirements for Portable Sealed Secondary Lithium Cells
description: Specifies requirements and tests for the safe operation of portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries containing non-acid electrolyte under intended use and reasonably foreseeable misuse.

title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Type Approval
description: Lays down requirements for the design qualification and type approval of terrestrial crystalline silicon photovoltaic modules suitable for long-term operation in open-air climates.

title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking - Specification
description: Specifies the fineness of gold alloys used for manufacture of jewellery and artefacts, together with statutory hallmarking requirements and consumer purity standards.

title: Silver and Silver Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking - Specification
description: Prescribes requirements for fineness and hallmarking identification of silver jewellery and artefacts manufactured in India.

title: Polyethylene for its Safe Use in Contact with Foodstuffs, Pharmaceuticals and Drinking Water
description: Specifies requirements and methods of sampling and test for polyethylene plastic materials for manufacture of containers, films, and piping intended to come into contact with foodstuffs.
technical_department: Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Department (PCD)

title: Domestic Stainless Steel Sinks - Specification
description: Specifies performance, dimensional, and anti-corrosion requirements for stainless steel sinks for domestic and institutional kitchens.
